evidence: The frozen environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template. Line 1 uses the template-required node:22-bookworm-slim version tag (not an immutable digest); lines 3 and 9-11 declare NODE_PATH and install express@5.1.0 plus better-sqlite3@12.4.1 during image build. Lines 14-23 copy both input directories, grant a+rX access, and create a git-initialized /app. No solution or tests COPY exists. Integration.md:3,5,7,13 promises exactly this server runtime; solution/app/package.json:13-19 separates these runtime dependencies from optional TypeScript/Vite build tools, and solve.sh:38 copies the already-built reference without installing anything. The task may use public browser assets; missing optional build tools is not a required runtime defect. I verified all 60 raw-evidence-index artifact hashes and independently ran the existing exact-current image sha256:001e7d851703c4bdda8e84ad85377bb1118009fa9333be4ad3e47b8accdc3230 in an owned --rm --network none container. Initial /app contained only .git and .gitkeep with clean git status. All six instructions and the seed matched frozen SHA256 values and were mode 755; the shared empty assets/artifacts directory also matched. Node was v22.23.2. Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 resolved from /usr/local/lib/node_modules; the native SQLite binding created, wrote, closed and reopened an actual database successfully. The frozen solve.sh then copied every reference file with matching hashes, with no /app/node_modules. Starting node /app/server.js from /tmp with a minimal declared environment created its DB and returned HTTP 200 for /api/health, /, and both bundled JS/CSS assets, without network access or installs. Counterexample challenge: a package-list-only inspection could miss a missing NODE_PATH or broken native SQLite binding. The negative-control child without NODE_PATH exited 1 with MODULE_NOT_FOUND, while the declared environment and native database probe passed. A conforming app that ships ordinary browser files and uses only the supplied server packages needs neither Vite nor local node_modules; the independently authored database fixture and installed golden demonstrated that path. No credible failing conforming runtime or undetected missing dependency was found within this row. The first probe failed because it tried to hash the empty assets/artifacts directory as a file; the unchanged image and frozen tree both contain that directory. The failure and original driver remain in container-attempt1.json/probe-attempt1.cjs, and only the probe was corrected. No task files, shared container, engine, scoring policy, or provider were changed. This is row-15 runtime evidence, not a configured judge, Oracle or portal grade.
